annotations.title: Save the user's answer to a question

description: Save the user's answer to an application question, so the extension uses it next time. Send only words the user gave you, never an answer you made up. job_id is needed when the question is about one company, such as why they want to work there. Needs the user signed in, with Needs attention (write).

job_id.description: The job it is for, from list_needs_attention.

question.description: The question as the form asks it.
